content.intro: Learn custom template tags and filters through a compact visual, an inspectable Django example, and a practical verification task.
content.why_it_matters: Custom Template Tags and Filters matters because a Django project has to behave predictably across requests, database state, configuration, and deployments. Understanding this piece makes the surrounding application easier to test, maintain, and secure.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: This lesson examines custom template tags and filters as part of advanced django architecture. The objective is to understand the behavior, connect it to the listed subtopics, and verify it with a small example rather than relying on memorized syntax.

content_blocks.title: What to cover
content_blocks.text: The source syllabus for this lesson names: Simple tags; Inclusion tags; Custom filters; Registration; Testing and organizing template extensions. Keep these distinct concepts together: know what each item does, when it applies, and what assumption must be verified in your project.

content_blocks.text: Common pitfalls include skipping a required configuration/import, copying a fragment without its model or URL context, trusting client input, or treating a development-only behavior as production-ready.
